name: Khalid Abdullah Al-Rashid
title: Chief Technology Officer
summary: Technology executive with two decades of experience transforming enterprises across the GCC. Fluent in organizational leadership, digital transformation and M&A technology integration. Board member and advisor to several regional technology organizations.

experience.title: Chief Technology Officer
bullets: Led SAR 600M digital transformation across 12 business units—45% cost reduction, 99.99% uptime
Built AI Center of Excellence: 15 ML models in production, 60% process automation
Migrated 200+ apps to hybrid cloud (Azure/AWS), saving SAR 45M annually
Led tech due diligence for SAR 1.6B in acquisitions; unified 5 ERPs to S/4HANA in 18 months
Achieved ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications; zero data breaches over 4 years
Scaled team from 120 to 290 across four countries; 87% retention rate

experience.title: Vice President, Technology & Digital
bullets: Deployed IoT predictive maintenance across 2,400 pieces of equipment, reducing unplanned downtime by 52% and generating SAR 120M in savings annually
Directed SAR 180M SAP implementation across finance, HR, supply chain, and project management; completed on-time and 12% under budget with 98% user adoption
Established technology innovation lab in partnership with KFUPM; incubated 8 internal startups with 3 commercialized generating SAR 25M in new revenue
Architected real-time data integration platform with Saudi Aramco, enabling automated compliance reporting and reducing administrative overhead by 64%

experience.title: Director, IT Infrastructure & Operations
bullets: Built Tier III data center (USD 18M investment), achieving 99.995% uptime and supporting 150% growth in trading system capacity
Pioneered VMware virtualization initiative reducing physical server footprint by 70% and cutting energy costs by USD 1.2M annually
Designed and implemented business continuity framework with RTO <4 hours; successfully executed during 2011 regional crisis with zero data loss

experience.title: Senior Manager, Applications Development
bullets: Launched Saudi's first mobile banking app—500K downloads, 5M monthly transactions
Rolled out Temenos T24 across 500+ branches with zero service disruption
Built applications development team from 12 to 35 engineers; established agile practices reducing defect rates by 65%
